lastTask: Implement Byte 17c-b SongGoal surprise and disposition taste nudges

projectState.summary: Byte 17c-b is implemented on codex/byte-17c-b. Applied SongGoal surpriseTarget and dispositionBias now derive adjusted PlayerTasteProfile thresholds used by the existing taste evaluator: surprise nudges novelty/repetition, and role bias nudges density target/tolerance. The player registry remains unchanged and window.taste.getProfiles() exposes base vs adjusted values. Scope stays deterministic and bounded: no model, no prose parsing, no direct action override, no note generation/removal, no persistence schema change. Validation so far: build green, smoke 38/38, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
